Virtualbox is a really clean and easy solution. It works very well with Windows VMs (easy full screen/ no resolution issues) ...

For something cooler since you are wanting to just run browsers and chain vpns I suggest KVM. Will be a bit more work but it's great for running headless linux vms. Then you can use X forwarding over SSH to have a firefox instance that looks like it's running on your host but is actually on the guest. Also if your host is connected to a VPN and you use NATd networking on your guest and start up a vpn on the guest then you have chained vpns.

You will want virt-manager package to have a graphical interface for creating VMs.

Also you can not run KVM and VBox at the same time but there is a way to switch back and forth you can find a script with some searching.

These are the 3 basic rules of firearm safety. Keep in mind it is irrelevant if the firearm is loaded or unloaded, these rules always apply.

  1. Treat it as if it is loaded
  2. Never point it at anything you're not willing to destroy
  3. Keep your finger off the trigger until you're ready to shoot

Other things to keep in mind:

  • Putting a firearm in a bag can be considered conceal carry depending on local laws. I think gun cases don't count because it's obvious it's a gun case.
  • Open carry is legal in lots of places. If you decide to open carry be prepared for idiots that don't know the law and are scared of inanimate objects to cause a scene.
  • Open carry gives you free reign to be in most public areas (there are exceptions like courthouses and schools), not private ones. If you try to open carry in a private establishment they have every right to tell you to GTFO.
  • Clean it after every use. It should come with instructions on how to do so, but it won't come with everything needed to do so.
